# Type graph parts of quicktype's Vitest tests (the rest of each test is
# rendering).
#
# test/unit/enum-order.test.ts: a schema enum keeps its case order through
# expand strings (all) and C#'s enum transformation.
builder
str day cases=Monday:1,Tuesday:1,Friday:1,Sunday:1 n=DaySchema
top DaySchema day
finish
expand all
print
query cases 1
maketx csharp
gc
print
query cases 2

# test/unit/rust-cycle-breaker-boxing.test.ts (graph part only; the boxing
# itself is rendering): Node.next is anyOf [Node, string, null], a
# canonical union that every pass keeps, recursive class included.
builder
str s unrestricted
prim nul null
reserve node
union next node,s,nul n=Next
ucls nodec open value:s,next?:next n=Node fwd=node
top Node node
finish
rmind
flatten
replaceobj
flatten
opt2null
fixedpoint
gc
print
